limitations.summary: A midpoint_to_destination period pays the mean of the whole monthly pay of the pay level and the destination level: base salary and every active fixed allowance (an allowance of one level counts as zero on the other); the base takes the rest of the rounded mean of the totals. A CCNL whose text leaves the averaged components open carries its own limitation <ccnl_id>/apprenticeship_midpoint_components, recorded on the midpoint path.
limitations.source: ccnl_engine.apprenticeship.rules._midpoint_chain; CCNL Aziende Termali Federterme 2024-2027 Art. 13 lett. g ('maggiorato di un importo pari al 50% del differenziale previsto tra il 5° e il 6° livello'); tests/knowledge/ccnl_engine/apprenticeship/rules/test_midpoint.py
limitations.remediation: Resolved: CCNLs whose midpoint components are unsourced are tracked by their own apprenticeship_midpoint_components limitation.

limitations.summary: Apprentices accrue only the CCNL apprentice-specific seniority increment, paid in full: the apprenticeship percentage no longer reduces it a second time. A CCNL that declares no apprentice amount pays none and carries its own open limitation <ccnl_id>/apprentice_seniority, recorded when the level pays matured increments.
limitations.source: ccnl_engine.compensation.element.rules and MonthlyPayChain.scaled_for_apprenticeship; apprentice amounts as sourced in the CCNL notes (acconciatura-estetica 2024 renewal Art. 25: 6 EUR; tessile-moda-artigianato 2024 renewal: 6 EUR; panificazione Art. 34-bis 'esclusi gli apprendisti' and 2024 renewal: 10 EUR; comunicazione-artigianato 2024 renewal: 10 EUR; legno-lapidei-artigianato 2024 renewal: 8 EUR); tests/knowledge/ccnl_engine/apprenticeship/rules/test_seniority.py
limitations.remediation: Resolved: the remaining CCNLs are tracked by their own apprentice_seniority limitation.

limitations.summary: A percentage apprenticeship reduces every fixed allowance whose apprenticeship_pct_relevant flag the data leaves at its default, together with the base salary. Whether the CCNL applies the percentage to that allowance (an EDR, a contingenza, a function allowance) was not sourced. The run is affected when such an allowance is in the apprentice's pay.
limitations.source: ccnl_engine.apprenticeship.rules (percentage track chain)
limitations.remediation: Source, for each CCNL, the elements the apprenticeship percentage applies to and set apprenticeship_pct_relevant on every allowance; the limitation then no longer applies to its runs.

limitations.summary: The INPS share of a sick day is computed on the INPS daily base of the episode, on the days INPS pays (the weekdays of an operaio, every day but the national holidays on a Sunday of an impiegato, point 7.3 of INPS circ. 134368/1981): the retribuzione media globale giornaliera of the month before the illness (INPS circ. 134368/1981 point 11; circ. 55/2024 Allegato 1), whole or partial month, impiegato or operaio, or for the lavoratori dello spettacolo the average pay of the last 40 daily contributions, capped for a fixed-term worker (INPS circ. 132/2021 par. 2.4). The base is a fact of the payroll history the episode states (SicknessEpisode.inps_base).
limitations.source: ccnl_engine.sickness.base.rules (daily base); ccnl_engine.sickness.pay.handlers (INPS share of a sick day)
limitations.remediation: Resolved: the INPS share is computed on the base of every regime of the bundle; an episode that states no base the engine can read has the missing_fact issue sickness_inps_base_unknown (fact inps_base), which blocks the run. Tests: tests/integration/ccnl_engine/sickness/base/test_rules.py, tests/unit/ccnl_engine/sickness/base/test_rules.py.

limitations.summary: The CCNL tier and the comporto are counted on the days of one episode and the relapses it continues. A CCNL that sums the sickness of separate episodes over a window (a calendar year, the last three years) can reach a lower tier or the end of the comporto earlier than the engine shows. The run is affected when an earlier episode outside the relapse chain is recorded. A CCNL whose comporto the engine counts over the calendar year (Commercio Art. 186 and the others with comporto_calendar_year) is not affected.
limitations.source: ccnl_engine.sickness.day.rules (CCNL tier of a sick day)
limitations.remediation: Add the cumulation window of each CCNL to its sickness rule, with the source, and count the tier and the comporto over it.

limitations.summary: The run reads a tax ruleset marked provisional: the sources of its year are not published yet (budget law of the year; regional and municipal surtax resolutions), so the values are those of the year before, carried over. Rules in force by statute (the IRPEF brackets of art. 11 and the deductions of art. 13 of the testo unico of D.Lgs. 117/2026) carry over unchanged; any change of the budget law is not applied.
limitations.source: ccnl_engine.assurance.ruleset.services.provisional_paths (tax ruleset of the run)
limitations.remediation: Replace each provisional ruleset of the year with the values of its published sources, drop its provisional flag, then resolve this limitation.

limitations.summary: The run reads an INPS ruleset marked provisional: the INPS circulars of its year are not published yet, so the rates, the massimale and the minimale (and the hourly contributions of domestic work) are those of the year before, carried over. The indexed amounts change every January: the carried-over values understate them.
limitations.source: ccnl_engine.assurance.ruleset.services.provisional_paths (INPS ruleset of the run)
limitations.remediation: Replace each provisional INPS ruleset of the year with the values of the INPS circulars of the year, drop its provisional flag, then resolve this limitation.

limitations.summary: An apprentice whose TFR goes to a pension fund or to the Fondo Tesoreria takes the 0.28-point relief of D.L. 203/2005 art. 8, but not the exemption from the 0.20% Fondo di garanzia contribution of D.Lgs. 252/2005 art. 10 c. 2: no source found says whether the apprentice rate (10% of L. 296/2006 art. 1 c. 773 plus NASpI and the integration funds) holds a Fondo di garanzia share to exempt. The employer contributions of the run may be overstated by 0.20% of the INPS base.
limitations.source: ccnl_engine.severance.relief.services; INPS messaggio n. 5859 of 7 March 2008, par. 3 (art. 8 relief of apprentices); INPS circ. 70/2007 par. 6 (Fondo di garanzia exemption, rates 0.20% and 0.40%)
limitations.remediation: Find an INPS source on the Fondo di garanzia share of the apprentice rate, then exempt it with the other workers or record that none is due.

limitations.summary: D.L. 463/1983 art. 7 c. 5 keeps the operai agricoli out of the 9.50% minimum daily base, and the run applies no minimum to them. Tabella A of INPS circ. 6/2026 still lists 51.70 for the operai agricoli, 'non soggetto all'adeguamento' of art. 7 c. 1; no source found says whether it is a floor of their contribution base. A base below it may understate the contributions.
limitations.source: ccnl_engine.contribution.minimum_base.services.minimum_base_paths; D.L. 463/1983 art. 7 cc. 1 and 5; INPS circ. 6/2026 allegato 1, Tabella A, note (2)
limitations.remediation: Source the role of the 51.70 of the operai agricoli (INPS circ. 43/2026 on the agricultural contributions, or the minimum daily wages of art. 1 L. 389/1989), then apply it as their minimum or record that none applies.

limitations.summary: The INPS maternity indemnity of an operaia, or of a leave whose month before was not worked in full, is computed on the pay of the run over 30 with the rateo of the extra months, not on the pay of the month before the leave: art. 23 c. 5 D.Lgs. 151/2001 divides the pay of an operaia by the days worked or paid (or by the hours, when fewer than the contract), and the divisor of her daily rateo of the 13th is not settled by a primary source. The base of another worker over a whole month is computed from MaternityLeaveEvent.maternity_base_pay.
limitations.source: ccnl_engine.absence.insured.base.rules.leave_base; D.Lgs. 151/2001 art. 23 (Normattiva, text in force on 2026-10-30, page sha256 f5d5e1ff3028f8249597c78f9371063f0de7790676054b5f0207c974bc50bc04)
limitations.remediation: Source the daily rateo of an operaia (an INPS circular on art. 23 c. 5) and compute her base and that of a month not worked in full, then resolve this limitation.

limitations.summary: The INPS indemnity of the compulsory paternity leave of an operaio, or of a leave whose month before was not worked in full, is computed on the pay of the run over 30 with the rateo of the extra months, not on the pay of the month before the leave: art. 29 D.Lgs. 151/2001 applies art. 23, whose c. 5 divides the pay of a manual worker by the days worked or paid (or by the hours) with a daily rateo no primary source settles. The base of another worker over a whole month is computed from PaternityLeaveEvent.paternity_base_pay.
limitations.source: ccnl_engine.absence.insured.base.rules.leave_base; D.Lgs. 151/2001 artt. 23 and 29 (Normattiva, text in force on 2026-10-30, page sha256 f5d5e1ff3028f8249597c78f9371063f0de7790676054b5f0207c974bc50bc04 and 3bfcc58c0e6f305f8971925b355d864c9bdf203e187fe40503c0df2aeca8a94a)
limitations.remediation: Source the daily rateo of a manual worker under art. 23 c. 5 and compute his base and that of a month not worked in full, then resolve this limitation.

limitations.summary: The INPS indemnity of the parental leave of an operaio or operaia, or of a leave whose month before was not worked in full, is computed on the pay of the run over 30 with the rateo of the extra months, not on the pay of the month before the leave: art. 34 c. 1 D.Lgs. 151/2001 applies art. 23, whose c. 5 divides the pay of a manual worker by the days worked or paid (or by the hours) with a daily rateo no primary source settles. The base of another worker over a whole month is computed from ParentalLeaveEvent.parental_base_pay.
limitations.source: ccnl_engine.absence.insured.base.rules.leave_base; D.Lgs. 151/2001 art. 34 (Normattiva, text in force on 2026-10-30, page sha256 aaf521a98f84e5d33cad1deee74452d789e5c58ec3d1ede4567453d7b7bd3967) and art. 23
limitations.remediation: Source the daily rateo of a manual worker under art. 23 c. 5 and compute his base and that of a month not worked in full, then resolve this limitation.

limitations.summary: The days of parental leave beyond the indemnified months (three of each parent and three of the couple, nine of a sole parent) are paid nothing: art. 34 c. 3 D.Lgs. 151/2001 pays them 30% when the parent's income is below 2.5 times the trattamento minimo di pensione, an income test and a yearly amount the engine does not model.
limitations.source: ccnl_engine.absence.insured.parental.rules.allocate; D.Lgs. 151/2001 art. 34 (Normattiva, text in force on 2026-10-30, page sha256 aaf521a98f84e5d33cad1deee74452d789e5c58ec3d1ede4567453d7b7bd3967)
limitations.remediation: Source the yearly trattamento minimo and the income the test reads, take the income as a fact of the leave and pay the further days at 30% when the condition holds, then resolve this limitation.

limitations.summary: When a counter of the parental leave (a rate band or the indemnified months) ends inside a calendar month of the leave that is not of thirty days, the engine pays the days of that month in order, one day of counter each and the last day what is left of the thirty: INPS counts the calendar month as one month (FAQ congedo parentale 2024, n. 10) but no source says which of its days fall in which band.
limitations.source: ccnl_engine.absence.insured.parental.rules.allocate; INPS FAQ congedo parentale 2024 n. 10 (pdf sha256 f3f4d4f68b1db21e9f3c7589c5fa2e584a398c055031c4bb1e6481a897f4461f)
limitations.remediation: Source how INPS splits a calendar month between two rates of the parental leave and apply it, then resolve this limitation.

limitations.summary: The days of parental leave accrue the 13th and the other extra months in full at the employer's charge (art. 34 c. 5 D.Lgs. 151/2001: the leave does not reduce them), while the INPS indemnity is computed on a base that already holds their daily rateo (art. 23 c. 2, INPS circ. 122/2022): no source read settles whether the employer's extra month is reduced by the share INPS pays, so the rateo of a month on leave may be overstated.
limitations.source: ccnl_engine.absence.insured.parental.handlers._handle_parental_leave; D.Lgs. 151/2001 art. 34 c. 5 (Normattiva, text in force on 2026-10-30, page sha256 aaf521a98f84e5d33cad1deee74452d789e5c58ec3d1ede4567453d7b7bd3967) and art. 23 c. 2
limitations.remediation: Source how the extra months of a parental leave are split between INPS and the employer and net the INPS share from the employer's rateo, then resolve this limitation.

limitations.summary: A parental leave by the hour takes half the average daily hours a day and counts two such days as one day of leave, the general criterion of art. 32 c. 1-ter D.Lgs. 151/2001 (INPS circ. 152/2015 par. 2.2); a collective agreement, also of the company, that sets other hours to a day of leave or other rules of cumulation prevails, and the bundle holds none.
limitations.source: ccnl_engine.absence.insured.parental.hourly.handlers._handle_hourly_parental; INPS circ. 152/2015 (sha256 6e74e62dd50378c23117df7aaca509ab9b8b93e60f99cad23e9c64982fd3734e) par. 2.2; INPS msg. 6704/2015 (sha256 df53a5985edfad727f8f7fcab3c2e21ee70181181ef35194935394157ef12204)
limitations.remediation: Source the collective rules on the leave by the hour of the CCNL (hours of a day of leave, cumulation) and apply them, then resolve this limitation.

limitations.summary: The days of permit under L. 104/1992 art. 33 c. 3 keep the TFR base, as payroll practice holds; art. 2120 c. 3 c.c. keeps in the TFR base only the absences of art. 2110 c.c. and the wage integration, and no primary source read says the permits are among them, so the TFR quota of a month with permits may be overstated.
limitations.source: ccnl_engine.absence.insured.permit.handlers._handle_disability_permit; D.Lgs. 151/2001 artt. 43-44 (Normattiva, text in force on 2026-10-30, page sha256 6bd9b8071e8c852ec96f3cdfdd2ee236d75a9bbb9ea0ef5d058d9315dd9c7888); art. 2120 c. 3 c.c.
limitations.remediation: Source the TFR treatment of the permit days (an INPS or Ministry ruling, or case law of the Cassazione) and apply it, then resolve this limitation.

limitations.summary: A notice partly worked pays the share of its calendar days left of the indemnity the CCNL band gives in monthly pays; the CCNL clause read (Federmeccanica Sez. Quarta Tit. VIII Art. 1) states the indemnity of the whole notice only, and practice also measures the rest by 30ths or 26ths of the monthly pay.
limitations.source: ccnl_engine.termination.notice.handlers._handle_notice_indemnity; art. 2118 c. 2 c.c. (Normattiva, page sha256 4452820aa5b54831d6c7295a8e1ac8035d9ea4babba3db388188c6101ab4cc3f)
limitations.remediation: Source how the CCNL or case law measures the indemnity of a notice partly worked and apply it, then resolve this limitation.

limitations.summary: The indemnity is the monthly pays of the CCNL band on the monthly pay of art. 2121 c.c.; the 13th and 14th the notice would have accrued are not added, although art. 2121 counts 'ogni altro compenso di carattere continuativo', so the indemnity may be understated.
limitations.source: ccnl_engine.termination.notice.handlers._handle_notice_indemnity; art. 2121 c.c. (Normattiva, page sha256 209f2f9e1b21f1c41b8d413496e3a5abf062616cf6d87f22c01625cbe3bf408f)
limitations.remediation: Source whether the indemnity carries the rateo of the extra months (CCNL clause or case law) and add it, then resolve this limitation.

limitations.summary: The notice indemnity enters the TFR base as payroll practice holds; art. 2120 c. 2 c.c. counts the sums paid 'a titolo non occasionale' and no primary source read settles whether this indemnity is among them, so the TFR quota of the termination run may be overstated.
limitations.source: ccnl_engine.termination.notice.handlers._handle_notice_indemnity; art. 2120 c.c. (Normattiva, page sha256 45dbc6519992406a3ed0e764b69b7367c8ebf6151d28e3ec193fe868e7b98c27)
limitations.remediation: Source the TFR treatment of the notice indemnity (case law of the Cassazione or a Ministry ruling) and apply it, then resolve this limitation.

limitations.summary: A CCNL that sets the notice in calendar days measures the indemnity on the pay of those days: the engine takes a calendar day as a 30th of the monthly pay; Commercio art. 209 refers the monthly pay to all the days of the calendar month, but its art. 210 sets the daily quota at 1/26 'in tutti i casi', so the indemnity may be understated.
limitations.source: ccnl_engine.termination.notice.handlers._handle_notice_indemnity; CCNL Terziario Confcommercio 30 luglio 2019 artt. 209-210, 248 (sha256 76420e3a21e002e2cb37b71db515356ee260a239c7cf38e7df94f68b8f730016)
limitations.remediation: Source the daily measure of the notice indemnity of the CCNL (an interpretation of the parties or case law) and apply it, then resolve this limitation.

limitations.summary: The daily indemnity of the extraordinary leave is the last monthly pay of fixed and continuous items times the monthly payments of a year over 365: art. 42 c. 5-ter D.Lgs. 151/2001 and INPS messaggio 30/2024 set the pay and its rateo of the extra months, and the INPS table of the yearly maximum divides it by 365 (2026: 43,486.00 / 365 = 119.14), but no source read states the divisor of the worker's own pay.
limitations.source: ccnl_engine.absence.insured.extraordinary.handlers._handle_extraordinary_leave; D.Lgs. 151/2001 art. 42 c. 5-ter (Normattiva, text in force on 2026-10-30, page sha256 ad8aa2d80253c1a760b5e39ac829afa76dc0156f73a1f115150cd2165306a87f); INPS scheda congedi straordinari (page sha256 3f12506c8279719647196c854ecdbd19c41de7d5c29af10e15909a06d5fa319f)
limitations.remediation: Source the daily divisor INPS applies to the last pay (circ. INPS 64/2001 or 32/2012) and apply it, then resolve this limitation.

limitations.summary: The NASpI contribution of the end of an employment is read from the cause, the just cause and the contract type alone. The request states none of the cases that change it: a resignation in the protected period of maternity and a mutual agreement before the labour office or on a transfer over 50 km owe it (INPS circ. 44/2013 par. 1); a collective dismissal without union agreement owes it three times (L. 92/2012 art. 2 c. 35); the changes of contractor with a social clause and the closures of a construction site of c. 34, and the reductions agreed under artt. 4 and 24 L. 223/1991, leave it out; the service counts the fixed-term periods before the open-ended contract and leaves out the leave of art. 42 c. 5 D.Lgs. 151/2001 only through EmploymentPeriod.started_on.
limitations.source: ccnl_engine.termination.naspi.services.naspi_dismissal; L. 92/2012 art. 2 cc. 31-35 (Normattiva, sha256 b73a86474e09ecb4a31eadfc49e86999fb944a8d787598c73f840a5f29fb31a6); INPS circ. 44/2013 (sha256 921fa38bef69508119c546fd0179ceff3e272224bd4ddea8f2e2949e09c89f07)
limitations.remediation: Add the facts of these cases to the end of the employment (EmploymentPeriod) and apply them, then resolve this limitation.

limitations.summary: Two garnishments of the same kind, or two salary assignments, share the measure of their kind (a fifth, or the tenth or seventh of the agente della riscossione) in the order of notification: art. 545 c. 4 c.p.c. sets 'un quinto per i tributi ... ed in eguale misura per ogni altro credito' and art. 5 DPR 180/1950 a cessione 'fino al quinto', but no text read says how two orders of the same kind split the measure, so the later order may be under- or overstated.
limitations.source: ccnl_engine.personal_withholding.services.same_kind_paths; art. 545 c.p.c. (Normattiva, page sha256 1fa0acce41c8fa68d80eba137bd4fcbe903016fa97ac4df183cc0ce55897ce66); art. 5 DPR 180/1950 (Normattiva, page sha256 461c2014ffdc7d93ddc0761877b9cd4b4964c256165ef252412a3c38a78a4919)
limitations.remediation: Source how the employer splits the measure between two orders of the same kind (art. 499 c.p.c. on the intervention of creditors, case law of the Cassazione) and apply it, then resolve this limitation.
